snippet.title: Super Trio arcade 2 player 60fps
snippet.description: Best viewed in 60 fps (only available on HTML5 player). I'm player 1 and Mark is player 2. This was played with an overclock setting to prevent severe slowdown which also interferes with the button inputs. The game crashed at the end of the stage 6 bonus, so I needed to save state to fix this. The player stats are slightly different between stage 6 and 7 because of that.
